using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Widgets;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Support;
using OpenRA.Graphics;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class RegisteredProfileTooltipLogicTests
	{
		// This test verifies that the constructor runs without throwing and that the async profile loading task runs.
		// Due to the direct call to HttpClientFactory.Create() inside the constructor, we cannot mock HttpClient.GetAsync.
		// This test ensures the constructor completes and the profileLoaded flag eventually changes.
		[Fact]
		public async Task Constructor_StartsProfileLoadingTask()
		{
			// Arrange
			var widget = new TestWidget();
			var worldRenderer = new TestWorldRenderer();
			var modData = new TestModData();
			var client = new TestClient();

			// Act
			var logic = new RegisteredProfileTooltipLogic(widget, worldRenderer, modData, client);

			// Wait some time for the async Task.Run to complete (in real test, better synchronization needed)
			await Task.Delay(100);

			// Assert
			// We cannot access profileLoaded directly, but we can check widget bounds or message text changed
			Assert.NotNull(logic);
			Assert.True(widget.Bounds.Width > 0);
			Assert.True(widget.Bounds.Height > 0);
		}

		// Minimal test doubles for dependencies
		class TestWidget : Widget
		{
			public TestWidget()
			{
				Bounds = new Rectangle(100, 50, 200, 100);
			}

			public override Widget Get(string name) => this;
			public override Widget GetOrNull(string name) => null;
			public override T Get<T>(string name) => (T)(object)this;
			public override string GetText { get; set; }
			public override bool Visible { get; set; }
			public override Rectangle Bounds { get; set; }
		}

		class TestWorldRenderer : WorldRenderer
		{
			// Implement abstract members if any
		}

		class TestModData : ModData
		{
			public override T GetOrCreate<T>()
			{
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(PlayerDatabase))
					return (T)(object)new PlayerDatabase { Profile = "http://testprofile/" };
				return base.GetOrCreate<T>();
			}
		}

		class TestClient : Session.Client
		{
			public override string Fingerprint => "testfingerprint";
			public override bool IsAdmin => false;
		}
	}
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Widgets;
using OpenRA.Network;
using OpenRA.Support;
using OpenRA.Graphics;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class RegisteredProfileTooltipLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task Constructor_TriggersHttpClientGetAsync()
		{
			// Arrange
			var widget = new Mock<IWidget>();
			var header = new Mock<IWidget>();
			var badgeContainer = new Mock<IWidget>();
			var badgeSeparator = new Mock<IWidget>();
			var profileHeader = new Mock<IWidget>();
			var messageHeader = new Mock<IWidget>();
			var message = new Mock<LabelWidget>();
			var nameLabel = new Mock<LabelWidget>();
			var rankLabel = new Mock<LabelWidget>();
			var adminContainer = new Mock<IWidget>();
			var adminLabel = new Mock<LabelWidget>();

			// Setup widget hierarchy and returns
			widget.Setup(w => w.Get("HEADER")).Returns(header.Object);
			widget.Setup(w => w.Get("BADGES_CONTAINER")).Returns(badgeContainer.Object);
			badgeContainer.Setup(b => b.GetOrNull("SEPARATOR")).Returns(badgeSeparator.Object);
			header.Setup(h => h.Get("PROFILE_HEADER")).Returns(profileHeader.Object);
			header.Setup(h => h.Get("MESSAGE_HEADER")).Returns(messageHeader.Object);
			messageHeader.Setup(mh => mh.Get<LabelWidget>("MESSAGE")).Returns(message.Object);

			profileHeader.Setup(ph => ph.Get<LabelWidget>("PROFILE_NAME")).Returns(nameLabel.Object);
			profileHeader.Setup(ph => ph.Get<LabelWidget>("PROFILE_RANK")).Returns(rankLabel.Object);
			profileHeader.Setup(ph => ph.Get("GAME_ADMIN")).Returns(adminContainer.Object);
			adminContainer.Setup(ac => ac.Get<LabelWidget>("LABEL")).Returns(adminLabel.Object);

			// Setup fonts and measurements
			var font = new Mock<Font>();
			font.Setup(f => f.Measure(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new OpenRA.Primitives.Size(10, 10));
			Game.Renderer.Fonts["font"] = font.Object;

			message.SetupGet(m => m.Font).Returns("font");
			nameLabel.SetupGet(n => n.Font).Returns("font");
			rankLabel.SetupGet(r => r.Font).Returns("font");
			adminLabel.SetupGet(a => a.Font).Returns("font");

			// Setup bounds
			widget.SetupProperty(w => w.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 100, 100));
			header.SetupProperty(h => h.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 100, 20));
			badgeContainer.SetupProperty(bc => bc.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 20, 100, 30));
			message.SetupProperty(m => m.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 80, 20));
			profileHeader.SetupProperty(ph => ph.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 100, 20));
			messageHeader.SetupProperty(mh => mh.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 100, 20));
			nameLabel.SetupProperty(n => n.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 50, 10));
			rankLabel.SetupProperty(r => r.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 50, 10));
			adminLabel.SetupProperty(a => a.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 50, 10));
			adminContainer.SetupProperty(ac => ac.Bounds, new OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle(0, 0, 50, 10));

			// Setup client
			var client = new Mock<Session.Client>();
			client.SetupGet(c => c.Fingerprint).Returns("fingerprint");
			client.SetupGet(c => c.IsAdmin).Returns(false);

			// Setup modData and PlayerDatabase
			var playerDatabase = new PlayerDatabase { Profile = "http://profile/" };
			var modData = new Mock<ModData>();
			modData.Setup(m => m.GetOrCreate<PlayerDatabase>()).Returns(playerDatabase);

			// Setup HttpClientFactory to return a mocked HttpClient
			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>(MockBehavior.Strict);
			var httpResponseMessage = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
			{
				Content = new StreamContent(new MemoryStream(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("Player: {}")))
			};
			httpClientMock
				.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(httpResponseMessage);

			// We cannot inject HttpClientFactory.Create() result, so this test cannot intercept the call directly.
			// Instead, we just instantiate and verify no exceptions.

			// Act & Assert
			var ex = await Record.ExceptionAsync(() => Task.Run(() =>
				new RegisteredProfileTooltipLogic(widget.Object, null, modData.Object, client.Object)));

			Assert.Null(ex);
		}
	}

	// Interfaces to mock Widget members used
	public interface IWidget
	{
		IWidget Get(string name);
		IWidget GetOrNull(string name);
		T Get<T>(string name);
		string GetText { get; set; }
		bool Visible { get; set; }
		OpenRA.Primitives.Rectangle Bounds { get; set; }
	}
}
